items.title: Securing REST APIs with JWT authorizers in Amazon API Gateway
items.summary: Amazon API Gateway REST APIs now support JWT authorizers, which validate tokens from any OIDC-compatible identity provider in API Gateway itself, with no Lambda authorizer required. Learn how JWT authorizers work, then build a REST API that accepts machine-to-machine tokens with per-method scopes and adds an Amazon Cognito user pool as a second issuer.
items.creator: Giedrius Praspaliauskas
